title: model.validated
description: A model was scored against test evidence, producing or updating its fidelity score and applicability envelope. This is the mechanism by which test-coupled M&S is realised (PSDD 4.2 #4, G-3, G-4): every test result regenerates models automatically.

regenerationTriggered.description: True when this validation caused the model implementation to be re-fit rather than merely re-scored.

approvedBy.description: Human approver; mandatory where the model informs safety-relevant output.
